labelChirho: pass away, come to an end
descriptionChirho: Of time, heaven, earth, or an era ceasing to exist or reaching its end, often in eschatological contexts.
To move past a location or person in physical space, traversing along a path.
To come forward to someone or arrive at a place, emphasizing approach rather than passing.
Of an ordeal or cup being taken away or averted, as in the Gethsemane prayer for the cup to pass.
To pass over or neglect a commandment, violating or ignoring an obligation.
